collection.title: Land Rover Discovery 1999 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Land Rover Discovery 1999 to 2004 model requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Latch arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
